transcript.text: Good to see everyone here. I'm Mara, the Festival Operations Director, and I'll be the one giving final authorization for our event's operating plan tonight. As I understand it, we're looking at a one-night audience-participation recreation of a scene from our featured film, using a movable scenic set, guided participant groups, and a marked route through the event space. Before I can sign off on the operating plan, I need each technical and compliance lead to place any final findings into the shared record using the formal finding-report step. Once that's done, I'll record any resulting documentation or follow-up work as commitments — and those don't need to be completed during this meeting for me to authorize. So let's get started. Who'd like to walk us through where things stand?

transcript.text: I need to formally enter a finding into the shared record. I have not yet entered this result in the operating plan, but I'm placing it into the record now via this formal finding-report step.
